summary: The first full-runner preflight invocation omitted a preflight-only mode and entered the 960-row loop while provider credentials were absent from the process environment.

evidence_interpretation.reason: Provider adapters return is_live=false without credentials; no successful live response was recorded.

corrective_actions: require OPENROUTER_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY in preflight
do not reuse invalid rows for resume
use a fresh execution directory for the authorized live matrix
